name: Baron Vault
lines: “Welcome to Goldvine Town. Everything you can see is mine, and everything you can’t see is in a vault, and also mine.”
“I rented the vaults to a pop star. And myself, as it turns out. Read the small print, child.”
win: “Burned. Take the Fire Badge. I’ll invoice you for it later.”
lose: “Money talks. Mine just won the argument.”
hint: Baron Vault’s Fire team is level 41–43. Water and Ground moves put Fire Billies out.

seat.title: Fire Badge · 6 of 8
seat.rewardText: a Golden Parachute, 4 Gold Coins and 2 Platinum Coins
seat.unlockText: The Grizzle Badlands, east of Goldvine Town, are open.
